name: Oldham County Summer 2026
information:
Oldham County Summer 2026 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBak44IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5480638ed1b138c4bbe41a46a7e7dbb34d1406e2/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

Oldham County Summer 2026 will be done in a stationary format, this format will be explained before the competition starts, and during the newcomer tutorial.
